name: turn-flow-legacy-projection-closeout
title: Retire live turn-flow legacy back-projection
description: Stop mutating canonical assistant turnFlow back into legacy chat message fields across the live frontend chat runtime.
creator: yudi
notes: 2026-04-21 full-repo audit confirmed that the frontend chat runtime still called `reconcileTurnFlowWithLegacy()` and `applyLegacyFieldsFromTurnFlow()` through live SSE, lifecycle, and finalize paths, repopulating canonical `turnFlow` into legacy `thinkingContent`, `optimizingTools`, `ragSources`, and `toolCalls`. 2026-04-21 closeout completed: live turn-flow writers now mutate only canonical `turnFlow`, chat rendering reads canonical turn-flow through selector helpers, and legacy fields remain bounded persisted-history fallback input instead of live writable truth.
